question: For what purposes may the vowed observance be set aside?
premises: An observance may be abandoned in some cases.
Acting for others is a possible purpose.
Protecting the world is a possible purpose.
inference: One may set it aside for the sake of others or for the protection of the world.
uncertainties: Object of parityayet is implied from context
plain_english: One should set it aside for the sake of others or for the protection of the world.
